mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.dept_id AS deptId, d.dept_name AS deptName, s.food_subsidy AS foodSubsidy, s.traffic_subsidy AS trafficSubsidy, s.housing_subsidy AS housingSubsidy FROM subsidy s LEFT JOIN dept d ON s.dept_id = d.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subsidy(dept_id, food_subsidy, traffic_subsidy, housing_subsidy) VALUES(#{deptId}, #{foodSubsidy}, #{trafficSubsidy}, #{housingSubsidy})
